description: Magical Armor uses the normal Armor value of its base equipment unless otherwise specified.

enchantments.name: Armor of Resilience
enchantments.effect: Gain Tough 1 while wearing this armor.

enchantments.name: Spellguard Armor
enchantments.effect: Gain Ward 6+ against Magic. If you already possess an applicable Ward against Magic, improve it by 1 step instead.

enchantments.name: Armor of the Bastion
enchantments.effect: If you did not Move during the Movement Phase, improve Armor by 1 step until your next Movement activation.

enchantments.name: Armor of Endurance
enchantments.effect: Gain +1 maximum Wound. Once per Round, reduce the first instance of Direct Damage you suffer by 1, to a minimum of 0.

enchantments.name: Shadow Armor
enchantments.effect: Improve Evade by 1 step. After Disengaging, gain Concealed until you Attack, enter Engagement, or the Round ends.
